dataset: BaTiO3 zero-field QE response reference set for MACEField tutorials
split_indexing: zero-based indices into the 59-frame source file
label_provenance_note: Energy, forces, stress, and polarization are from zero-field Quantum ESPRESSO calculations. BECs are obtained from finite differences of forces with respect to applied fields, and polarizability from finite differences of polarization, using perturbations through ±0.36 V/Å on the same fixed geometries. The processed field tag is zero and matches the zero-field mechanical labels.
coverage_note: Direct energy, force, stress, and polarization labels are at zero field; BEC and polarizability response labels use finite-field perturbations through ±0.36 V/Å. There are no field-cycled MD labels or labeled switching paths.
configuration_provenance_note: The source workflow documents BTO configurations as Flare active-learning structures, not AIMD. They are genuine QE-labeled response structures, but are not described as AIMD.
